headline: Kenya Revenue Authority Seizes Illicit Cigarettes Worth Sh12 Million
summary: The Kenya Revenue Authority seized illicit cigarettes valued at Sh12 million during a multi-agency operation in Gatundu North, Kiambu County.
why: Crackdowns on contraband goods protect government tax revenues and combat illicit trade within domestic markets.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: Enforcement actions curb contraband trade and protect tax receipts.
